item.title: ELLE List: The Ones Making Maximalism Cool Again
item.description: Trends have been circling back for a while now, with 2016 nostalgia leading the charge. While most of us are busy recalibrating chokers, tank tops, and skinny jeans for today, a certain set of creators has opted out of the revival altogether. Their language is maximalism — always has been. Unapologetic, layered, and joyfully excessive. No throwbacks, no references. Just personal style, turned all the way up. Scrolling through their Instagram feeds feels oddly refreshing. Almost a little defiant.
